source: Re-check 2026-11-15. Rates unchanged from the 2026-10-22 snapshot (which was verified against https://www.etsy.com/legal/fees/). On 2026-11-15 etsy.com was not reachable from the engine's cloud session (blocked by the environment's network policy), so the Etsy rates were cross-checked against secondary 2026 fee guides (verify_urls_secondary), all of which agree: $0.20 listing, 6.5% transaction, 3% + $0.25 US processing, 15%/12% Offsite Ads. etsy.notes: Transaction fee applies to price + shipping + gift wrap, not US sales tax. Processing applies to the total incl. tax and shipping.

payhip.notes: 5% is the Free-plan platform fee. 2.9% + $0.30 is Stripe US standard processing, confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-22. PayPal checkout uses PayPal's own rate, not modeled here; re-snapshot if PayPal is enabled.

one_time.notes: Paid once at Etsy shop opening (owner-reported 2026-10-22). Counts toward Day 0 cash, not per-sale fees.
